description: This file contains composable functions for rendering news resource cards in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes UI components like images, text, bookmarks, and topic tags related to news resources, along with preview functions for design inspection.

methods.name: NewsResourceCardExpanded
methods.description: Main composable to display an expanded news resource card with image, title, bookmark, metadata, description, and topics.

methods.name: NewsResourceHeaderImage
methods.description: Displays header image with loading indicator and error fallback.

methods.name: NewsResourceTitle
methods.description: Displays the title of the news resource.

methods.name: BookmarkButton
methods.description: Toggle button for bookmarking or unbookmarking a news resource.

methods.name: dateFormatted
methods.description: Formats an Instant date into a localized date string.

methods.name: NewsResourceMetaData
methods.description: Displays formatted publish date and resource type.

methods.name: NewsResourceShortDescription
methods.description: Shows a brief description of the news resource.

methods.name: NewsResourceTopics
methods.description: Displays topics associated with the news resource as tags.
